title: Brand configuration
description: The product's names, addresses, legal documents and marks: the one brand configuration every application reads, through its generated brand module.

$schema.description: Editor hint pointing at this schema; not part of the generated modules.

$comment.description: Free text for maintainers; not part of the generated modules.

productName.description: The product's name wherever the applications show it.

assistantName.description: The assistant's name in the interface and in model instructions. Defaults to "<productName> Assistant". It names a product feature, never a person.

legalEntityName.description: The legal name of the company that operates the service, as it appears in legal documents and notices.

appUrl.description: Public address of the web application.

marketingUrl.description: Public address of the product website.

securityEmail.description: Mailbox for security reports (security.txt and the security policy).

docsUrl.description: Public address of the user documentation.

changelogUrl.description: Public address of the release notes.

sourceRepositoryUrl.description: Public repository holding the complete corresponding source code of the running service.

upstreamAttribution.description: The project this software is derived from, credited wherever attribution is shown.

author.description: Author or organization of the upstream project.

url.description: Address of the upstream project's source.

license.description: SPDX identifier of the upstream licence.

notice.description: One-sentence attribution shown in the interface.

legalDocuments.description: The legal documents users and customers are pointed to, each with its address, version and status.

subprocessors.description: List of subprocessors and model providers.

aiTransparency.description: Statement on how AI is used, by which providers, and its known limitations.

clientAiUse.description: Plain-language explainer a firm can give its clients on how AI is used on their matter, with an engagement-letter clause.

security.description: Security overview and vulnerability disclosure policy.

assets.description: Paths of the brand's image files, as served by the web application.

glyph.description: Square mark used where space is tight.

wordmark.description: The product name as a logotype.

palette.description: Brand colours. onPrimary on primary must reach a 4.5:1 contrast ratio (checked by the generator).

onPrimary.description: Text and icon colour placed on primary.

displayFace.description: Typeface for display text, chosen from the faces bundled with the web application.

docxAuthorLabel.description: Author name on tracked changes and document properties the assistant writes into Word files. Defaults to assistantName.

displayText.description: Plain text: no surrounding spaces, no angle brackets, no control characters.

assetPath.description: A root-relative path to an image the web application serves.

url.description: Where the document is published: an absolute https address, or a path in the web application.

version.description: Version of the document users accept or are shown, for example 2026-11-01 or 1.2.0.

status.description: draft: written but not in effect (pending legal review); in-effect: the version that applies.
